title: Scan Seen (Daily Barcode Log)
description: Tracks which barcodes a player has scanned each day. Enforces one-barcode-per-day-per-player rule. Persisted in scan_seen table. Composite PK (player_id, barcode).

seen_at.description: ISO 8601. When this barcode was last scanned by this player. Upserted on every scan; daily-reset filter uses date(seen_at) = date('now').
